Ethan (Sales): passing VestraHealth to CS — midmarket healthtech. Pilot 90 days, 5 seats, expected low concurrency. They require Okta SSO, EU data residency, and connector to their SIEM (Sentry). Renewal approx 9 months. @Rina can you take lead? Contract link: https://redwood.at/agreements/vestra-pilot

Rina (CS): happy to. quick clarifying q: will they run only hosted private or request dedicated GPUs for model-heavy routes? Also need tech contact.

Ethan (Sales): Tech contact is "Sofia Mendes" (sofia@vestra.co). For pilot they expect hosted private (VPC) but may request Dedicated if latency >200ms on their workflows. They also want audit exports for compliance.

Noah (Infra): for VPC private in eu-west we need their allowed CIDRs, preferred peering method, and if they want mutual TLS. Also note Sentry ingestion: we'll need outbound egress to sentry.io and an API key.

Sam (Support Eng): Sentry usually ingests JSON over HTTPS. We should clarify which events they want (audit vs app logs). I can draft minimal mapping. Any timezone constraints for kickoff?

Ava (Onboarding PM): I can schedule. Recommend: 20-min kickoff + 45-min enablement. Morning CET preferred. Rina, want me to block Tue/Thu next week?

Rina (CS): Tue morning CET works. I'll run kickoff. Action owners proposed:
- Collect CIDRs + certs + Sentry token (owner: Sofia / Vestra)
- Confirm SSO metadata (Okta org + idp-redirect URL) (owner: Ethan)
- Provision private eval (eu-west) (owner: Noah)
- Create pilot feedback doc (NPS + 3 workflow checks) (owner: Rina)
- Schedule kickoff + enablement invites (owner: Ava)

Ethan (Sales): adding: compliance flag for healthcare data (not PHI now but they asked about future). Please surface to security.

Sam (Support Eng): noted. I'll add a troubleshooting checklist: common cert mismatch, HEC token errors, firewall blocks. Will link to runbook after draft.

Noah (Infra): infra snippet for tracking:
```bash
# create eval instance
redwoodctl create private --region eu-west-1 --profile vestra-pilot --size m8g
```
I'll open INF ticket once CIDRs are in.

ticket-bot: INF-9007 created: provision-private-eval-vestra (assigned: Noah)

Rina (CS): please also add renewal owner to Gainsight (Ethan) and set renewal reminder + risk tag. I'll start a shared pilot doc (owner: Rina) with goals, success criteria, and feedback form.

Ethan (Sales): I'll add renewal info. Sofia said she'll send CIDRs and Sentry token by tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:

Ava (Onboarding PM): will send invites when Sophia's assets arrive. Rina, I can include a 15-min pre-kickoff run for their infra folks if needed.

Rina (CS): yes please. Also let's capture two success metrics: <10% error rate on inference calls and avg latency <250ms for key route. I'll add to pilot doc.

Sam (Support Eng): will prepare Sentry mapping + quick checklist and post link. Also will note token rotation cadence.

Rina (CS): summary: Ethan handoff, Sofia to deliver assets, Noah infra ticket INF-9007, Ava schedule, Sam runs runbook, Rina owns pilot doc + feedback. I'll email Sofia the owners and next steps after this thread. :white_check_mark:
